name: Phase 93 Reviewed Note, Task, and Journal Creation Manual UI Evidence

testedInteractions: Renders typed proposal card with headline, destination, date, and timezone metadata
Displays 'Local Draft (Unsaved)' amber badge for pending proposals
Allows clicking 'Edit' to enter inline form edit mode for title, date, and details
Saves edited payload via client.updateAiProposal, rotating token and updating review summary
Cancels proposal via client.cancelAiProposal without writing any database records
Confirms proposal via client.confirmAiProposal, displaying 'Saved (Cloud Persisted)' green badge
Renders 'Open Created Item' button that navigates directly to /library, /plan, or /journal via canonical deep links

accessibilityAttributes.keyboardNavigation: All edit fields, confirm, edit, cancel, and open buttons accessible via Tab and Enter
accessibilityAttributes.contrast: Conforms to WCAG AA on light and dark themes using tokens

testedInteractions: Renders mobile-friendly proposal card inside ScrollView with handled keyboard taps
Displays 'Local Draft (Unsaved)' vs 'Saved (Cloud Persisted)' status chip
Provides Quick Propose buttons (+ Note, + Task, + Journal) for immediate review creation
Renders editable TextInput fields for title, date, and content in edit mode
Executes confirm and calls onOpenSource to navigate to created note, task, or journal

accessibilityAttributes.touchTargetMin: Meets 48dp minimum for all mobile buttons and quick chips
accessibilityAttributes.screenReaderLabels: Full accessibilityLabel coverage on all action controls
